title: Falsifiable Compositional Reasoning in Time Series Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2611.25388v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Time series foundation models as well as the language-guided analytical agents achieve strong accuracy on standard chronological benchmarks. However, models that rank highest on historical validation splits often degrade across non-stationary regime transitions. We hypothesise that this gap arises from using historical backtesting as an open-ended search and model-selection objective instead of using it to test pre-specified compositional assumptions. Real-world time series are generated by recurring latent primitives that co-move within finite historical windows. Under strong historical co-movement, chronological holdout error cannot separate predictors that learn invariant couplings among primitives from predictors that fit transient historical correlations. translated_title: 时间序列预测中可证伪的组合推理
translated_abstract: 时间序列基础模型以及语言引导的分析智能体在标准时序基准测试中取得了很高的准确率。然而，在历史验证集划分上排名最高的模型，在非平稳状态转换中往往会发生性能退化。我们假设这种差距源于将历史回测用作开放式的搜索与模型选择目标，而不是用它来检验预先指定的组合假设。现实世界的时间序列由在有限历史窗口内共同运动的重复潜在基元所生成。在强烈的历史共运动条件下，时序保留误差无法将学习基元之间不变耦合的预测器与拟合瞬态历史相关性的预测器区分开来。在大量架构、超参数或思维链规则池中进行搜索，会进一步使模型选择偏向于历史捷径。通过理论分析与诊断（原文摘要至此截断）……
tldr: 该论文提出时间序列模型在非平稳状态转换下的性能退化源于将历史回测用作开放式搜索与模型选择目标而非检验预先指定的组合假设，并主张采用可证伪的组合推理框架来区分真正学习不变耦合与拟合历史捷径的模型。
en_tdlr: This paper argues that performance degradation of time series models under non-stationary regime shifts stems from using historical backtesting as an open-ended search and model-selection objective rather than testing pre-specified falsifiable compositional assumptions, and proposes a framework to distinguish predictors learning invariant couplings among latent primitives from those fitting transient historical correlations.
